text: Generated assets/characters/ALR-001-turnaround.png with gpt-image-2 in one call — verified 3840x2160 RGB PNG, 15,471,974 bytes — the Alaric sheet gating every Video 3 frame from beat 6 on. It satisfies the brief: face consistent and readable in the three front-facing views (back view shows only the back of the head, same as FRI-001), reads tired and watchful not heroic, late-antique scale armour with no plate or mail, plain annular fibula, and no text or emblem anywhere. Caveats: 3840x2160 against the other turnarounds' 1536x1024 so he is more painterly at native size, sword sits on a baldric half-hidden by the cloak, and STATE.md decision 1 on his parentage is still open.
